title: Owner Auto-Enrollment — Zero-setup speaker recognition
source_plan: user request 2026-04-24 — automatic owner enrollment eliminates manual CLI setup
notes: Currently owner enrollment requires 'heare speaker enroll owner' CLI command. Guest auto-enrollment exists after 2+ matching turns. This feature extends auto-enrollment to the owner, with a higher threshold (5 turns) for safety, and speaks a Ukrainian confirmation message when enrollment succeeds.

stories.title: Settings: speaker_id_auto_enroll_owner_* knobs
stories.description: Add configuration fields to Settings for owner auto-enrollment. Defaults to enabled with a conservative 5-turn threshold (higher than guest's 2 turns) to prevent accidental enrollment.
acceptanceCriteria: src/config.py Settings has: speaker_id_auto_enroll_owner_enabled: bool = True
src/config.py Settings has: speaker_id_auto_enroll_owner_after: int = 5
tests/test_config.py includes a test verifying speaker_id_auto_enroll_owner_enabled defaults to True
tests/test_config.py includes a test verifying speaker_id_auto_enroll_owner_after defaults to 5

stories.title: SpeakerTaggerProcessor: owner auto-enroll logic in _maybe_auto_enroll()
stories.description: Extend _maybe_auto_enroll() to check for owner enrollment BEFORE guest enrollment. Reuses _stranger_candidates deque, checks if owner already exists (never overwrite), and calls gallery.enroll_owner() when threshold is met.
acceptanceCriteria: src/speaker_processor.py _maybe_auto_enroll() checks 'owner' not in gallery._speakers before attempting enrollment
_maybe_auto_enroll() checks speaker_id_auto_enroll_owner_enabled setting before proceeding
_maybe_auto_enroll() compares matches+1 against speaker_id_auto_enroll_owner_after threshold
When threshold met: calls gallery.enroll_owner(new_embed, 'owner'), logs success, clears _stranger_candidates, returns early (skips guest enrollment)
When owner already exists: owner enrollment path is skipped entirely, guest enrollment proceeds normally
Failed enrollment (exception) is caught, logged as warning, does not crash the processor

stories.title: TTS notification: speak Ukrainian phrase on successful owner enrollment
stories.description: When owner is auto-enrolled, push a TTSSpeakFrame with a Ukrainian confirmation message so the user hears that enrollment succeeded.
acceptanceCriteria: After gallery.enroll_owner() succeeds, _maybe_auto_enroll() imports TTSSpeakFrame from pipecat.frames.frames
TTSSpeakFrame is pushed with Ukrainian text: 'Тепер я впізнаю твій голос.' (Now I recognize your voice)
TTS push is wrapped in try/except; failure is logged but does not prevent enrollment
Log includes '[SPEAKER] auto-enrolled owner after N turns' message with turn count

stories.title: Tests: owner auto-enrollment unit tests
stories.description: Add comprehensive unit tests for owner auto-enrollment behavior in test_speaker_processor.py.
acceptanceCriteria: test_auto_enroll_owner_when_no_owner_exists: verifies enroll_owner called after threshold met, TTS pushed, buffer cleared
test_auto_enroll_owner_skipped_when_owner_exists: verifies enroll_owner NOT called when 'owner' in gallery
test_auto_enroll_owner_respects_threshold: verifies enroll_owner called on 5th turn (not before) with default threshold
test_auto_enroll_owner_handles_enrollment_failure: verifies exception caught, logged, does not crash
test_auto_enroll_owner_checks_enabled_flag: verifies nothing happens when speaker_id_auto_enroll_owner_enabled=False
